# TP-Link Easy Smart Provider

Manages TP-Link Easy Smart switches (TL-SG108E v6) over their native UDP management protocol. The provider must run on the same layer-2 network as the switch, and only one switch per Terraform run is supported (the switch always replies to UDP port 29809).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tplinkeasysmart = {
      # Replace the namespace with the one the provider is published under.
      source = "local-infra/tplinkeasysmart"
    }
  }
}

variable "switch_host" {
  type        = string
  description = "Management IP address of the switch (same layer-2 network as the machine running Terraform)."
}

variable "switch_username" {
  type = string
}

variable "switch_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "tplinkeasysmart" {
  host     = var.switch_host
  username = var.switch_username
  password = var.switch_password

  # Seconds to wait for a reply before retrying a request (default 3).
  # timeout_seconds = 3
}

# Alternatively leave the provider block empty and export
# TPLINK_EASYSMART_HOST, TPLINK_EASYSMART_USERNAME and TPLINK_EASYSMART_PASSWORD.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) IPv4 address or hostname of the switch. Falls back to TPLINK_EASYSMART_HOST.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password. Falls back to TPLINK_EASYSMART_PASSWORD.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait for a reply before retrying a request. Defaults to 3.
- `username` (String) Admin user name. Falls back to TPLINK_EASYSMART_USERNAME.
